objective: maximize the platform score with the remaining slots

recipe.definition: iron = V32_iron + 0.5 * (mean(r seeds) - J42); the incumbent uses r = 3, the candidate uses r = 6, so the change is 0.5 * (mean6 - mean3)

expected_effect_basis.model: W(r) = A + c/r fitted on the recorded per-seed predictions

evaluation: per split: candidate = reference_iron + 0.5*(mean6 - mean3); iron-only score gain = 50*(WMAPE_incumbent - WMAPE_candidate)
gate: both complete splits positive; then a separately frozen full-data release
limits: Two split seeds only; the four-complete-seed promotion gate needs a separately frozen confirmation.
The expected effect is an extrapolation of a 1/r fit on three seed counts; it is not a measured gain.
No platform score may be forecast and the assistant does not upload.
fold_source_note: query_ids of each recorded unit; verified identical to the de3-independent-batches OOF member columns at 0.0
incumbent_column_source_note: reference_iron (the incumbent iron column) plus old_members (the three recorded DE3 seeds) on the same folds
